dataset: Toyota ABS-EE to SEC 10-D recovery component exception ledger

field_definitions.asset_recovered_amount_signed: Monthly sum of ABS-EE EX-102 recoveredAmount from the receipt-bound existing audit; EX-103 says it covers amounts recovered on a Defaulted Receivable during the reporting period and includes repossession proceeds.
field_definitions.certificate_net_liquidation_proceeds_sig: Current-period signed row from the SEC Servicer's Certificate; proceeds appear negative in its liquidations table.
field_definitions.certificate_recoveries_previously_liquid: Current-period signed row for recoveries on previously liquidated contracts.
field_definitions.certificate_aggregate_net_liquidation_pr: Positive collection amount. Exact identity checked as the negated sum of the two signed liquidation rows.
field_definitions.asset_minus_certificate_recovery_delta: ABS-EE recoveredAmount sum less certificate Aggregate Net Liquidation Proceeds; no residual is allocated or forced to zero.

method: Exact Decimal arithmetic on source values. Certificate component identities are checked independently from the ABS-EE-to-certificate recovery residual. Missing values are not filled; no recovery rate, LGD, PD or forecast is computed.
limitations: The two Toyota trusts share issuer/servicer family and are not two independent issuers.
All month-level ABS-EE versus certificate recovery residuals remain unresolved unless tied exactly; this ledger does not infer the cause.
The 2024-B certificate row and current-period recoveries are not assigned to asset-level certificate buckets without transaction-level evidence.
No asset identifiers or loan-level records are included in the output.
